system.description:
Your [Attack Power] increases by +4. The strength of the [Barrier] you gain from "Swashbuckler" increases by +10. A small shield shaped like a rose. The petals, woven from fabric imbued with magic power, protect against blades, and the thorns arranged around the perimeter can also be used as a weapon. Its elegant appearance makes it popular as a fashion accessory, but it is also a first-rate utility item.

Goblin Army War Banner [Core Material] (380G) + Cross Shield (470G) + Baselard (440G) ×2 + [Magic Catalyst 15] (220G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (560G)
